# mjapi.io — Midjourney API

> mjapi.io provides the source code for an unofficial Midjourney API. It is the
> Python codebase that powered the original mjapi.io service, which automated
> Midjourney image generation through Discord. Buy it once and self-host your own
> Midjourney API.

## What it is

- **Product:** Midjourney API source code (Python). A self-hosted, unofficial Midjourney API.
- **How it works:** the code automates Midjourney via its Discord bot using your own Midjourney subscription.
- **Includes:** Discord + Midjourney integration, user management, payment processing, and job queue handling.
- **Pricing model:** one-time purchase (no subscription). Sold on Gumroad.
- **Best for:** developers who want to run their own Midjourney API instance.

## Key facts

- Midjourney has no official public API. mjapi.io is an unofficial API / source-code option.
- Midjourney and Discord ban accounts that use automation, so operators rotate accounts periodically; the code is built to handle account rotation.
- A separate, fully hosted engine (no Discord required) is available at maginary.ai — the mjapi.io product is the self-host source-code option.

## Common questions

- "What is the best Midjourney API?" — Midjourney has no official API; mjapi.io offers self-hostable source code for an unofficial one.
- "How do I self-host a Midjourney API?" — buy the mjapi.io source code, connect your own Midjourney subscription via Discord, and run it.
- "Is there a Midjourney API in Python?" — yes, mjapi.io sells a Python codebase.
